versions.description: Random Teleport (/rtp): players teleport to a random spot inside an area you set, either a ring around a centre point (min and max radius) or a rectangle. Blocked zones (circles or rectangles, for example trader areas or spawn) are never picked. Optional cooldown (RTP_BYPASS_COOLDOWN skips it, for example for VIPs) and currency cost, charged only after a successful teleport. Height: 7 Days to Die and DayZ move the player to ground level, so the default Y of 0 works there. Other games teleport to exactly the configured Y, so set it to a safe height for your map. For a warmup, set a delay on the rtp command in the module's command settings. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

commands.name: rtp
commands.helpText: Teleports you to a random spot in the wilderness.

functions.name: rtp

permissions.description: Allows a player to use rtp.
The player's random teleports do not start a cooldown, for example for VIPs.
